notes.raw:
\*Data extrapolated above 1600 K. 
Phase changes: 1090 K, melting point of Eu; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 2.202$ kcal/mol. 
1800 K, boiling point of Eu; $\Delta H^{\circ} = 34.585$ kcal/mol. 
Heat capacity (cal/mol·K) and enthalpy (kcal/mol) equations: 
298.15-2000 K: $Cp^{\circ} = 11.173 + 2.236 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.267 \times 10^{5} T^{-2}$ 
$H^{\circ}-H_{298}^{\circ}=11.173\times10^{-3}T+1.118\times10^{-6}T^{2}-0.267\times10^{2}T^{-1}-3.341$ 
Reaction equations (kcal/mol): 
298.15-1090 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = -125.824 + 2.706 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} - 1.322 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 23.750 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -125.824 - 2.706 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} + 1.322 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} + 11.875 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 40.419 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1090-1800 K: $\Delta Hr^{\circ} = -125.410 - 2.108 \times 10^{-3} T + 0.958 \times 10^{-6} T^{2} - 60.850 T^{-1}$ 
$\Delta \mathrm{Gr}^{\circ} = -125.410 + 2.108 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 0.958 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 30.425 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 8.891 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
1800-2000 K: $\Delta \mathrm{Hr}^{\circ} = -168.223 + 2.922 \times 10^{-9} \mathrm{T} + 0.703 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 60.850 \mathrm{T}^{-1}$ 
$\Delta Gr^{\circ} = -168.223 - 2.922 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T} \ln \mathrm{T} - 0.703 \times 10^{-6} \mathrm{T}^{2} - 30.425 \mathrm{T}^{-1} + 69.919 \times 10^{-3} \mathrm{T}$ 
Sources: Enthalpy of formation based on Smoes (108) and Kaldis (60). Low-temperature heat capacities and entropy at 298 K based on Teaney (115). High-temperature data based on McMasters (78). Data extrapolated above 1600 K.
